sourceChecks.text: They came to Hilkiah the high priest and delivered the money that was brought into God’s house, which the Levites, the keepers of the threshold, had gathered from the hands of Manasseh, Ephraim, of all the remnant of Israel, of all Judah and Benjamin, and of the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 候補名の指示対象を節本文・文脈で確認。

sourceChecks.text: When they brought out the money that was brought into the LORD’s house, Hilkiah the priest found the book of the LORD’s law given by Moses.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 候補名の指示対象を節本文・文脈で確認。

sourceChecks.text: Hilkiah answered Shaphan the scribe, “I have found the book of the law in the LORD’s house.” So Hilkiah delivered the book to Shaphan.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 候補名の指示対象を節本文・文脈で確認。

sourceChecks.text: Shaphan the scribe told the king, saying, “Hilkiah the priest has delivered me a book.” Shaphan read from it to the king.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 候補名の指示対象を節本文・文脈で確認。

sourceChecks.text: The king commanded Hilkiah, Ahikam the son of Shaphan, Abdon the son of Micah, Shaphan the scribe, and Asaiah the king’s servant, saying,
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 候補名の指示対象を節本文・文脈で確認。

sourceChecks.text: So Hilkiah and those whom the king had commanded went to Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tokhath, the son of Hasrah, keeper of the wardrobe (now she lived in Jerusalem in the second quarter), and they spoke to her to that effect.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 候補名の指示対象を節本文・文脈で確認。

sourceChecks.text: His princes gave a free will offering to the people, to the priests, and to the Levites. Hilkiah, Zechariah, and Jehiel, the rulers of God’s house, gave to the priests for the Passover offerings two thousand six hundred small livestock, and three hundred head of cattle.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 候補名の指示対象を節本文・文脈で確認。

profileDecisionJa: ヒルキヤはヨシヤ王の時代の大祭司です。主の律法の書が見つかったとき、それをシャファンに渡した祭司として記されています。
